framework.title: NHS Fellowship in Clinical AI Curriculum
framework.publisher: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust Clinical Scientific Computing
framework.description: Educational framework for NHS frontline workers to develop clinical AI expertise alongside clinical roles.

release.label: Version 3.2 (Cohort 3)
release.verificationNote: Public source and content verified on 12 August 2026. Faculty must confirm the canonical release for Cohort 5 or later before assignment.
release.releaseNotes: Initial oPortfolio package. Published cross-mappings remain at domain level; no objective-level equivalence is asserted.

deliveryMethods.title: Immersive clinical AI project
deliveryMethods.description: Supervised experiential project work in a live NHS clinical AI team, potentially including publication or research.

deliveryMethods.title: Small group workshops
deliveryMethods.description: Monthly interactive expert-led masterclasses that complement and extend other learning.

deliveryMethods.title: E-learning
deliveryMethods.description: Didactic and self-paced modules, exercises, assignments and deadlines through programme-selected learning resources.

deliveryMethods.title: Networking
deliveryMethods.description: Mentorship, peer learning, site visits, alumni events and pastoral faculty sessions.

duties.title: Work in an agile multidisciplinary team
duties.description: Work as a member of an agile multidisciplinary team including AI specialists, medical physicists, IT, health economists and clinicians.

duties.title: Communicate with clinical AI stakeholders
duties.description: Communicate with hospital management, patients, clinicians, regulators and technology developers.

duties.title: Curate clinical datasets lawfully
duties.description: Curate clinical datasets in accordance with data-protection law and regulation.

duties.title: Deploy clinical AI safely
duties.description: Deploy clinical AI in a safe, legal, equitable and effective way.

duties.title: Evaluate clinical AI in workflows
duties.description: Critically evaluate the performance of clinical AI in hospital workflows.

duties.title: Present scientific findings
duties.description: Present scientific findings in clinical AI including clinical trials and quality-improvement projects.

duties.title: Develop policy and standards
duties.description: Understand and develop policies and standards for clinical AI regulation.

domains.title: AI Fundamentals
domains.description: Algorithms, data, tools, training, optimisation, metrics and validation foundations.

objectives.title: Select and apply AI algorithms
objectives.sourceText: Understand and apply different types of AI algorithms for different tasks, including logistic regression, decision trees, support vector machines, random forest, K-means clustering, neural networks and Bayesian approaches.

objectives.title: Understand training-data provenance, quality and structure
objectives.sourceText: Understand data provenance, quality and structure requirements for training AI algorithms, including synthetic data, metadata, taxonomies, ontologies and standards.

objectives.title: Perform data extraction and wrangling
objectives.sourceText: Perform data extraction and wrangling, including feature labelling and extraction, dimensionality reduction and normalisation.

objectives.title: Understand AI training types
objectives.sourceText: Understand types of training for AI algorithms, including supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement, ensemble, distributed and federated learning.

objectives.title: Use AI languages and frameworks
objectives.sourceText: Understand types of languages and frameworks used to create and analyse AI algorithms, including Python, R and SQL.

objectives.title: Train and optimise algorithms
objectives.sourceText: Understand and apply AI algorithm training and optimisation, including hyperparameter tuning, internal validation and optimal stopping.

objectives.title: Apply algorithm performance metrics
objectives.sourceText: Understand and apply common AI algorithm performance metrics, including precision, recall, F1 score and Receiver Operator Characteristic.

objectives.title: Understand validation methods
objectives.sourceText: Understand AI algorithm validation methods, including hold-out and cross-validation.

domains.title: Regulation & Standards
domains.description: Medical-device regulation, data protection, clinical risk, research governance and law.

objectives.title: Understand medical-device marking and certification
objectives.sourceText: Understand CE and UKCA marking and methods for obtaining certification for different classes of medical device for AI technology.

objectives.title: Apply GDPR to AI technology
objectives.sourceText: Understand and apply GDPR to AI technology.

objectives.title: Apply clinical risk-management standards
objectives.sourceText: Understand and apply NHS clinical risk-management standards to AI technology, including DCB0129 and DCB0160.

objectives.title: Apply research and service-evaluation governance
objectives.sourceText: Understand and apply HRA definitions of clinical research and service evaluation to AI evaluation and implementation, following the appropriate governance for each.

objectives.title: Understand AI clinical decision-making law
objectives.sourceText: Understand legal frameworks applying to AI technology in clinical decision making, including negligence, product liability and consent.

domains.title: Validation & Evaluation
domains.description: Evidence appraisal, local validation, monitoring, incidents, error and bias.

objectives.title: Critically appraise AI literature
objectives.sourceText: Critically appraise published literature relating to AI algorithms using established evidence standards where appropriate, including the NICE evidence standards framework.

objectives.title: Understand local model validation
objectives.sourceText: Understand local AI model validation, including prospective clinical studies and guidance such as SPIRIT-AI and CONSORT-AI.

objectives.title: Manage post-deployment monitoring and incidents
objectives.sourceText: Establish and manage post-deployment monitoring, evaluation and iteration of AI technology, including detecting, reporting and managing adverse effects or serious incidents related to AI.

objectives.title: Measure and mitigate error and bias
objectives.sourceText: Understand, measure and mitigate potential sources of error and bias in AI algorithms, including circumstances leading to inequitable distributions of patient outcomes and medical algorithmic audit methodology.

domains.title: Integration & Systems Impact
domains.description: Technical integration, workflow, impact, human factors, failure, explainability and procurement.

objectives.title: Integrate AI with healthcare IT
objectives.sourceText: Integrate AI technology with existing healthcare IT systems.

objectives.title: Design clinical workflows for AI
objectives.sourceText: Design and redesign clinical workflows to integrate AI technology, applying interoperability and user-centred design principles.

objectives.title: Evaluate systems impact
objectives.sourceText: Evaluate AI impact in health-economic measures, service efficiency, patient outcomes, workforce and environment.

objectives.title: Understand cognitive biases in AI interaction
objectives.sourceText: Understand how interactions with AI may be affected by automation, aversion, confirmation and rejection biases and alert fatigue.

objectives.title: Understand and respond to AI failure modes
objectives.sourceText: Understand AI failure modes, how they differ from human clinical-reasoning errors, including outlier detection and adversarial attacks, and how to respond.

objectives.title: Understand AI explainability
objectives.sourceText: Understand the principles and limitations of AI explainability.

objectives.title: Understand healthcare AI procurement
objectives.sourceText: Understand principles and guidelines for AI technology procurement in healthcare.

domains.title: Strategy & Culture
domains.description: Teams, partnership, transformation, leadership, workforce learning and public co-design.

objectives.title: Develop multidisciplinary teams
objectives.sourceText: Participate in and develop multidisciplinary teams for the creation and deployment of AI technology.

objectives.title: Collaborate with academia and industry
objectives.sourceText: Collaborate effectively with colleagues in academia and industry.

objectives.title: Apply transformation and change management
objectives.sourceText: Understand and apply digital transformation and effective change-management principles.

objectives.title: Build leadership support and champions
objectives.sourceText: Establish leadership buy-in and support internal champions for change for AI technology.

objectives.title: Understand NHS workforce learning needs
objectives.sourceText: Understand the learning and development needs of NHS staff for AI technology.

objectives.title: Co-design ethical and accessible AI with patients and public
objectives.sourceText: Understand the needs and expectations of patients and public for ethical and accessible AI through co-design principles.
